title: Grade 4 Math — Thu, Jun 19
description: Geometry — Day 4 of 5: Types of triangles
subject: mathematics

questions.question: A triangle has:
questions.explanation: A triangle has exactly 3 sides and 3 angles. The sum of all angles in a triangle is always 180°.

questions.question: The sum of all angles in any triangle is:
questions.explanation: The sum of angles in any triangle = 180°. This is always true, no matter what type of triangle.

questions.question: An EQUILATERAL triangle has:
options: All 3 sides different; all 3 angles different
All 3 sides equal; all 3 angles equal (each 60°)
questions.explanation: Equilateral = all equal. All 3 sides equal, all 3 angles = 60°. Equi = equal, lateral = sides.

questions.question: Each angle of an equilateral triangle is:
questions.explanation: All three angles are equal and sum to 180°. 180° ÷ 3 = 60° each.

questions.question: An ISOSCELES triangle has:
options: Exactly 2 equal sides (and the angles opposite the equal sides are also equal)
questions.explanation: Isosceles = 2 equal sides. The angles opposite (across from) the 2 equal sides are also equal.

questions.question: A SCALENE triangle has:
options: All 3 sides different lengths (and all 3 angles different)
questions.explanation: Scalene = unequal. All 3 sides are different, so all 3 angles are different too.

questions.question: A triangle with sides 5 cm, 5 cm, and 5 cm is:
A triangle with sides 4 cm, 4 cm, and 7 cm is:
questions.explanation: Two sides equal (4 cm = 4 cm) → isosceles triangle.

questions.question: A triangle with sides 3 cm, 5 cm, and 7 cm is:
A RIGHT TRIANGLE has:
questions.explanation: A right triangle has exactly one 90° angle. The other two angles are acute and sum to 90°.

questions.question: An ACUTE triangle has:
questions.explanation: An acute triangle has all three angles less than 90°. An equilateral triangle is always acute.

questions.question: An OBTUSE triangle has:
questions.explanation: An obtuse triangle has one angle greater than 90°. Since angle sum = 180°, only one angle can be obtuse.

questions.question: A triangle has angles 90°, 45°, and 45°. Classify it BY ANGLES:
questions.explanation: It has one 90° angle → right triangle. (By sides, since two angles are equal, it is also isosceles.)

questions.question: In a triangle, two angles are 70° and 60°. What is the third angle?
A triangle has all angles less than 90° and all sides equal. It is classified as:
questions.explanation: All angles equal (60°, all acute) → acute triangle. All sides equal → equilateral. So: acute equilateral triangle.
